description: Unified OpenAI-compatible gateway to 500+ models, with 72 models billed at $0/M for both input and output tokens. New accounts get 10 shared trial calls across the free models with no expiry and no credit card; a $1 top-up switches the account to permanent daily quotas (5 requests/minute, 100 requests/day, and 1 million tokens/day per model).
name: AIHubMix
setup_instructions:
1. Create an account at https://aihubmix.com (no credit card required).
2. Create an API key at https://console.aihubmix.com/workspaces/default/keys.
3. Set AIHUBMIX_API_KEY to that key.
4. Point an OpenAI-compatible client at https://aihubmix.com/v1 with Authorization: Bearer $AIHUBMIX_API_KEY (use /v1/messages with x-api-key for Anthropic-format requests and https://aihubmix.com/gemini for Gemini-format requests).
